title: Lesson 10
paragraph: 使いやすい画面と利用者支援

words.meaning: the controls and displays through which a person interacts with a system
words.japaneseMeaning: ユーザーインターフェース
words.example: The user interface includes a search box and a list of results.

words.meaning: the ability of people with different needs and disabilities to use a digital product
words.example: The team improved accessibility by adding keyboard controls.

words.meaning: how effectively and easily intended users can complete tasks with a product
words.japaneseMeaning: 使いやすさ・ユーザビリティ
words.example: The usability test showed that people struggled to find the save button.

words.meaning: the ways users move between pages, screens, or sections of a digital product
words.japaneseMeaning: 画面間の移動・ナビゲーション
words.example: Clear navigation helps users return to the main menu.

words.meaning: an option that limits search results to items meeting a chosen condition
words.example: Use the search filter to show only files created this month.

words.meaning: a key or combination of keys used to carry out a command
words.japaneseMeaning: キーボードショートカット
words.example: The keyboard shortcut saves the file without opening a menu.

words.meaning: a short help message shown beside a control when a user points to or focuses on it
words.japaneseMeaning: ツールチップ・短い補足表示
words.example: A tooltip explains what the unfamiliar button does.

sentencePractice.prompt: When the pointer pauses over a button, a small message appears beside it to explain the button's purpose. This contextual help is a ____.
sentencePractice.reviewNote: Help triggered beside a pointed-to control is a tooltip; an event notification and a tracked support request do not name this interface feature.

words.meaning: an approach in which a page layout adapts to different screen sizes
words.japaneseMeaning: レスポンシブデザイン
words.example: Responsive design keeps the form usable on a narrow phone screen.

sentencePractice.prompt: The page rearranges its layout to fit a phone, tablet, or wide desktop screen. This approach is called ____.
sentencePractice.reviewNote: Adapting layout to screen size defines responsive design; encoding information and keeping data copies consistent are different processes.

words.meaning: the process of finding the cause of a technical problem and working toward a solution
words.japaneseMeaning: トラブルシューティング・問題の原因調査と解決
words.example: Troubleshooting began with checking the network connection.

words.meaning: a tracked request for technical help that records an issue and its progress
words.japaneseMeaning: サポートへの問い合わせ記録・チケット
words.example: The support ticket includes a description of the failed upload.
